summary.description: A friendly, specific update acknowledging verified progress and distinguishing new findings from existing discussions, without a readiness verdict.

path.description: Repository-relative path to a file changed by the pull request.

start_line.description: First changed line covered by the comment. Use the same value as line for a single-line comment.

line.description: Last changed line covered by the comment on the right-hand side of the diff.

body.description: A concise explanation of the issue, why it matters, and what should change.

replacement.description: Exact replacement for the selected lines, or an empty string when a safe edit cannot be supplied.

existing_thread_id.description: ID of an existing unresolved thread about the same issue, even if its wording or location changed. Use an empty string only for a new finding.

thread_updates.description: Re-checks of existing unresolved bot threads. Omitted threads remain open.

thread_id.description: An existing thread ID from the supplied review context.

status.description: Use fixed only after verifying the correction in the current documentation or implementation. Outdated anchors alone are not evidence of a fix.

reason.description: A short explanation of the current evidence, identifying the text or code that fixes the finding when status is fixed.
